scope: Read-only adapter and actual staged/coverage/composite artifact review; no app, runner, exporter, browser or test execution by reviewer.

findings.evidence: Independently hashed all 2,294 original full-tree files against the pre-retry seal and manifest, plus full.log. Seal filesystem timestamp precedes retry started timestamp. Original receipt remains complete=true, passed=false, partial=false: 76 passing suites and auth exit 1. Its auth report retains 91 pass/20 browser-closed errors across 111 cases. Original failure is not relabeled.

77 unique inventory/selected suite names agree. Each composite row is structurally identical to its original passing row, except auth is exactly the whole retry row with explicit attempt label. Retry is complete=true, partial=true, passed=true, selected=[auth]; 111 names match original in order, all pass. Both attempts contain exactly 91 unique passing syntax records. Exit receipt is original=1/retry=0.

All 2,256 raw capture entries accounted for: 2,092 original non-auth +102 retry-auth copied byte-for-byte; every one of 62 original-auth captures superseded, including earlier successful contexts. Selected suite set is exactly 59 original native suites +auth retry. Input has only these 2,194 capture JSONs; manifest is outside it. All 16 required source/location assets match originals; 16 cross-attempt collisions are byte-identical. No excluded original auth capture enters input.

Independent JSON/set arithmetic over 8,330 selected records verifies source hashes/current LF bytes, raw executable lines against native location assets, covered-line containment, EOF-return filtering, per-suite hit unions and every emitted LCOV DA/LF/LH record. Exactly 480 suite/file contexts, 60 tests, 8 files; 10,324/11,100 executable lines (93.009009%). All 103 genuine exclusions and 8 EOF source exclusions match saved captures/assets. Exporter raw hash unchanged.

Final batch-011-validation.json selects exactly manifest rows and binds exact manifest/LCOV hashes, totals and source hashes. It explicitly records full_attempt_passed=false, initial exit1, retry exit0, effective_gate_passed=true and composite_after_browser_interruption. Runner selfcheck log contains its success receipt. All 91 source raw/LF pins, config and four supplemental raw pins remain exact at review end.

limits: Browser-closure root cause remains unknown. This is a transparent composite recovery, not an uninterrupted passing full runner or proof that an environmental fault cannot recur.

Review accepts this exact frozen inventory and artifacts. Adapter uses assertions, trusted coordinator inputs and fixed counts; it is not a generic recovery protocol for changed suites, arbitrary failures or modified source. No broad rerun is justified by the inspected evidence.

Native executable-line coverage is not branch coverage. Existing synthetic service/provider boundaries and original test oracles apply; no live account/data claims. Post-merge database ingestion/publication is outside this review.
